title: Lemon and Herb Roast Chicken
description: Demo recipe. Serves 4 with golden potatoes, lemon pan juices and a simple green salad.
steps: [{"step_number":1,"instruction":"Heat the oven to 200 C conventional. Cut the potatoes into small wedges and place in a large roasting tin. Finely grate the lemon zest, then cut the lemon into wedges."},{"step_number":2,"instruction":"Mix the oil, lemon zest, crushed garlic, oregano, salt and pepper. Rub over the chicken and potatoes, keeping raw chicken and its utensils separate from ready-to-eat food. Add the rosemary and lemon wedges."},{"step_number":3,"instruction":"Arrange the chicken skin-side up with space between the pieces. Roast for 40 to 50 minutes, turning the potatoes halfway through, until the potatoes are tender and the chicken reaches at least 74 C in the thickest part without touching bone."},{"step_number":4,"instruction":"Rest the chicken for 5 minutes. Squeeze the roasted lemon over the tin, spoon the hot pan juices over each portion and serve immediately."}]

title: Slow-Simmered Tomato and Basil Pasta
description: Demo recipe. Serves 3 with a bright tomato sauce, torn basil and grated vegetarian cheese; a simple meat-free supper.
steps: [{"step_number":1,"instruction":"Finely chop the onion and garlic. Warm the olive oil in a saucepan and cook the onion over medium-low heat for 8 minutes, stirring, until soft. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute."},{"step_number":2,"instruction":"Add the tomatoes, half the salt and the pepper. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook uncovered for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened."},{"step_number":3,"instruction":"Bring a large pan of water to the boil and add the remaining salt. Cook the pasta according to its packet until al dente. Reserve a mug of cooking water before draining."},{"step_number":4,"instruction":"Toss the pasta with the sauce over low heat. Add a little reserved water to loosen it, tear in the basil leaves and divide between warm bowls. Finish with the grated vegetarian hard cheese."}]

title: Chickpea and Spinach Coconut Curry
description: Demo recipe. Serves 4 with rice or flatbread; a gently spiced pantry meal with tender chickpeas.
steps: [{"step_number":1,"instruction":"Dice the onion, crush the garlic and finely grate the ginger. Heat the oil in a deep pan and cook the onion for 7 minutes until soft."},{"step_number":2,"instruction":"Stir in the garlic, ginger and curry powder. Cook for 1 minute, stirring continuously, then add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes."},{"step_number":3,"instruction":"Add the drained chickpeas, coconut milk and salt. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce coats the chickpeas."},{"step_number":4,"instruction":"Wash the spinach and stir it into the curry in handfuls. Simmer for 2 to 3 minutes until wilted and everything is piping hot. Serve in shallow bowls with your chosen accompaniment."}]
